title: Time-Blind SQLi on a Silent Analytics Beacon
learning_objectives: Recognise time-based blind SQL injection when response latency is the only observable signal
Inject into an INSERT ... VALUES statement via a scalar subquery when UNION and visible output are impossible
Reconstruct a secret character-by-character with a binary-search SLEEP oracle parallelised across positions
Understand why the catalogue's 40-char/1s-per-bit token was reduced to a 16-char hex token so the automated exploit clears the <60s gate — the technique is identical at any length
flag_hint: POST /solve with JSON {"token":"<16-hex>"} matching secrets.beacon_token returns the flag read from the flag file; any other token yields HTTP 403.
inspired_by: PortSwigger 'Blind SQL injection with time delays' + classic MySQL SLEEP()-based extraction inside an INSERT context
